description: This Java class, ModelTheme, models theme configurations for the OFBiz widget system. It parses XML elements defining themes, visual themes, templates, and resource maps, and provides accessors for these configurations.

classes.name: ModelTheme
classes.description: Represents a theme configuration including visual themes, templates, properties, and resource mappings within the OFBiz widget system.

methods.name: <constructor>
methods.description: Initializes ModelTheme object from XML element, parsing theme details, and loading visual themes, templates, and other properties.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of this theme.

methods.name: getVisualThemeIds
methods.description: Returns a list of IDs for visual themes associated with this theme.

methods.name: getVisualTheme
methods.description: Retrieves a specific VisualTheme object by its ID.

methods.name: getDefaultViewSize
methods.description: Returns the default view size property.

methods.name: getAutocompleterDefaultViewSize
methods.description: Returns the default size of the autocompleter view.

methods.name: getAutocompleterDefaultMinLength
methods.description: Returns the minimum number of characters before autocompletion activates.

methods.name: getAutocompleterDisplayReturnField
methods.description: Indicates whether the autocompleter shows the return ID field.

methods.name: getAutocompleterDefaultDelay
methods.description: Returns the delay in milliseconds before autocompletion activates.

methods.name: getLinkDefaultLayeredModalHeight
methods.description: Returns default height for layered modal windows.

methods.name: getLinkDefaultLayeredModalWidth
methods.description: Returns default width for layered modal windows.

methods.name: getLookupHeight
methods.description: Returns the default height for lookup windows.

methods.name: getLookupWidth
methods.description: Returns the default width for lookup windows.

methods.name: getLookupPosition
methods.description: Returns positioning information for lookup windows.

methods.name: getLookupShowDescription
methods.description: Returns whether to show description in lookup.

methods.name: getProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a theme property by name.

methods.name: getThemeResources
methods.description: Provides access to theme resource properties.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the type of a template identified by name.

methods.name: getEncoder
methods.description: Returns the encoder type for a template.

methods.name: getCompress
methods.description: Returns compression configuration for a template.

methods.name: getContentType
methods.description: Returns content type for a template.

methods.name: getEncoding
methods.description: Returns encoding for a template.

methods.name: getScreenRendererLocation
methods.description: Returns the renderer location for screen templates.

methods.name: getFormRendererLocation
methods.description: Returns the renderer location for form templates.

methods.name: getTreeRendererLocation
methods.description: Returns the renderer location for tree templates.

methods.name: getMenuRendererLocation
methods.description: Returns the renderer location for menu templates.

methods.name: getErrorTemplateLocation
methods.description: Returns the location of error templates.

methods.name: getModelCommonScreens
methods.description: Returns the map of common screen resources.

methods.name: getModelCommonForms
methods.description: Returns the map of common form resources.

methods.name: getModelCommonMenus
methods.description: Returns the map of common menu resources.
